summary: This table presents a financial performance summary for the periods ending September 30, 2024, and September 30, 2023, highlighting key metrics such as revenues, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit. The revenues increased by 5.1% year-over-year, reaching ₹40,986 million, while the net profit after minority interest also saw a rise to ₹6,506 million, reflecting a growth of 4.7%. Operating expenses totaled ₹3,863 million, with a slight increase in the operating margin percentage to 21.1%. The table further details earnings per share (EPS) metrics, showing a basic EPS of ₹15.71 and a diluted EPS of ₹15.68, indicating a positive trend in profitability. Additionally, the quarter-over-quarter growth metrics provide insights into recent performance changes, with notable increases in other income and profit before income taxes.
